calls.title: GrowthBook and MediaHub
calls.summary: GrowthBook (Jake Stangl, Daniel Wathne from sales, and Logan Bates from solutions engineering) discussed their experimentation platform with Anas Ahmed (MediaHub’s data/analytics team). Anas highlighted pain points around ad hoc analytics using R/Python scripts and a limited marketing platform, lacking structure and deeper insights. Next steps: Daniel will send a demo clip and documentation; Anas will share these with his head of analytics James to discuss internal buy-in and a potential follow-up.
